Maximum capacity (Emax) 3 kg up to and including 15 kg 20 kg up to and including 100 kg 200 kg up to and including 1500 kg
Minimum dead load 0 kg
Accuracy Class C
Rated Output 2 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) 3000 5000 3000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / vmin 7900 10000 7000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR) 9500 5000 5500
Input impedance 410 Ω ± 15 Ω
Temperature range -10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,7
Humidity Class CH
